2.325.1
DataSet.Name
The DataSet.Name attribute specifies a unique identifier for a DataSet. This attribute MUST be
specified. The value of this attribute MUST be a case-sensitive CLS-compliant identifier [UTR15].
The value of the DataSet.Name attribute MUST be unique among all datasets, data regions, and
groups in the report.
Following is the parent element of the DataSet.Name attribute.
Parent elements
DataSet
The following is the XML Schema definition of the DataSet.Name attribute.
 <xsd:attribute name="Name" type="xsd:normalizedString" use="required" />
